# Transcriptome findings {#pcgr-rna}

```{r rna_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

site_rna_pdf <- pcg_report$settings$conf$sample_properties$site
fusion_cs_pdf <- pcg_report$content$fusion$callset
fusions_pdf <- fusion_cs_pdf$variant_display
n_fusions_pdf <- NROW(fusions_pdf)
expr_pdf <- pcg_report$content$expression
outliers_pdf <- expr_pdf$outliers
immune_pdf <- expr_pdf$immune_contexture
immune_caption_pdf <- paste0(
  "Immune contexture: estimated relative proportions of immune cell types ",
  "in the RNA sample (quanTIseq).")
```

```{r fusion_pdf}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(pcg_report$content$fusion$eval)

cat("## RNA fusions\n\n")
## ranking as in pcgrr:::rank_fusions() - described according to the
## recurrence data available for the tumor site of the sample
site_specific <- !site_rna_pdf %in% c("Any", "") && n_fusions_pdf > 0
n_site <- if (site_specific) sum(pcgrr:::mitdb_site_count(
  fusions_pdf$MITDB_EVIDENCE, site_rna_pdf) > 0) else 0
cat("RNA fusion events detected in the sample (**n = ", n_fusions_pdf, "**) ",
    "are annotated with respect to known cancer gene partners (proto-",
    "oncogenes) and recurrence in the ",
    "[Mitelman Database](https://mitelmandatabase.isb-cgc.org/) of ",
    "chromosome aberrations and gene fusions in cancer. ",
    "Fusions are ranked by actionability tier (AMP/ASCO/CAP), then ",
    if (site_specific) paste0(
      "by the number of Mitelman DB records in ", site_rna_pdf, " cancers (",
      if (n_site > 0) paste0(n_site, " of the fusions recorded") else
        "none of the fusions recorded", "), then "),
    "by the number of supporting split reads. ",
    "The biomarker evidence of actionable fusions is listed under *Clinical ",
    "actionability*.\n\n", sep = "")
n_filt <- fusion_cs_pdf$n_filtered_split_reads
if (isTRUE(n_filt > 0)) {
  cat("*", n_filt, " fusion event", if (n_filt == 1) "" else "s",
      " with fewer than ", pcg_report$settings$conf$rna_fusion$min_split_reads,
      " supporting split reads ", if (n_filt == 1) "was" else "were",
      " excluded.*\n\n", sep = "")
}
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(paste0(
  "Quality control of fusion events (e.g. number of supporting reads, frame, ",
  "domain retention, presence in normal tissue) must be performed upstream ",
  "of PCGR - the focus here is on functional annotation and potential ",
  "clinical impact. Mitelman Database recurrence is annotated at the level ",
  "of fusion partners, not exact breakpoints; absence from the database ",
  "does not rule out biological relevance."),
  title = "Quality control and recurrence of fusion events", kind = "warning"))
```

```{r expression_pdf}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(pcg_report$content$expression$eval)

ref_cohort <- if (NROW(outliers_pdf) > 0 && "REF_COHORT" %in% colnames(outliers_pdf))
  paste(unique(outliers_pdf$REF_COHORT), collapse = ", ") else NA
cat("## Gene expression\n\n")
cat("### Overexpressed oncogenes and underexpressed tumor suppressors\n\n")
cat("Protein-coding gene expression outliers are genes with expression ",
    "levels at the extreme ends of the distribution in the reference cohort",
    if (!is.na(ref_cohort)) paste0(" (**", ref_cohort, "**)"),
    ": in the top or bottom percentiles (above 95 or below 5), beyond ",
    "*Q3 + 1.5 IQR* or *Q1 - 1.5 IQR*, and with a Z-score above 2 or below ",
    "-2. Only **proto-oncogenes with increased expression** and **tumor ",
    "suppressor genes with reduced expression** are listed here, ranked by ",
    "absolute Z-score (expression level: ",
    "*log2(TPM + 0.001)*); all outliers are available in the TSV/Excel ",
    "output.\n\n", sep = "")
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(paste0(
  "Comparing expression levels to reference cohorts must be interpreted with ",
  "caution, given potential biases in RNA sequencing protocols ",
  "[@Zhao2020-ln], and that the ",
  "reference cohorts (TCGA) mainly contain primary tumors. Outliers should ",
  "be considered a starting point for further investigation."),
  title = "Interpretation of expression outliers", kind = "warning"))
```

```{r expression_pdf_high}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(pcg_report$content$expression$eval)
outliers_high_pdf <- if (NROW(outliers_pdf) > 0)
  pcgrr:::pdf_table_expression_outliers(
    outliers_pdf, "Increased expression", color = report_color) else NULL
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_label("Increased expression - proto-oncogenes"))
if (is.null(outliers_high_pdf)) {
  cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", 
    "No proto-oncogenes with increased expression (outliers)."))
}
```

outliers_high_pdf
```

```{r immune_pdf_plot}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(pcg_report$content$expression$eval) && NROW(immune_pdf) > 0
#| fig-width: 3.4
#| fig-height: 1.8
#| out-width: 49%
#| fig-cap: !expr immune_caption_pdf
pcgrr:::pdf_plot_donut(
  data.frame(cell_type = immune_pdf$cell_type,
             N = immune_pdf$fraction,
             Pct = immune_pdf$fraction / sum(immune_pdf$fraction) * 100),
  category = "cell_type", center_label = "", show_counts = FALSE)
```

```{r similarity_pdf}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(pcg_report$content$expression$eval) && isTRUE(as.logical(pcg_report$settings$conf$expression$similarity_analysis))

sa <- expr_pdf$similarity_analysis
sources <- list(
  "Primary tumors (TCGA)" = dplyr::bind_rows(sa[grepl("tcga", names(sa))]),
  "Cell lines (DepMap)" = sa[["depmap"]],
  "Pediatric tumors (Treehouse)" = sa[["treehouse"]])
cat("### Similarity to other tumor samples\n\n")
cat("Correlation (Spearman, protein-coding genes) of the expression profile ",
    "with samples from external sources - the ten most similar samples per ",
    "source are shown, with samples from the primary site of this tumor ",
    "highlighted.\n\n", sep = "")
shown <- 0
for (src in names(sources)) {
  tt <- pcgrr:::pdf_table_expression_similarity(
    sources[[src]], site = site_rna_pdf, n = 10, color = report_color)
  if (is.null(tt)) next
  shown <- shown + 1
  cat(pcgrr:::pdf_label(src), "```{=typst}\n",
      tinytable::save_tt(tt, output = "typst"), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
}
if (shown == 0) {
  cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", "No expression similarity results available."))
}
```
